title: Bellum Civile
description: Bellum Civile with its Coop compat module (coop-compat/BellumCivileCoopCompat) in Coop: every part of the module finds what it patches in this Bellum; the server ends civil wars and claim feuds and the players see them end; a player's realm votes on peace and on Bellum's treaties, held to an ally's call to arms; and Bellum's politics run on the server only, so a player's PC files no votes, founds no kingdoms and follows the server's diplomacy and relations.
